name: Liferun
verdict: Liferun's last 7 days showed strong efficiency gains, with CPL dropping 43.63% and leads up 33.33% despite a 24.84% reduction in spend, suggesting Meta's budget is working harder. Google Ads remains a concern, consuming $1,950.18 over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions, and its spend was cut 53.48% week-over-week likely as a response to that underperformance.

performance.verdict: Meta efficiency is real; Google burns $1,950 with zero conversions — fix attribution or pause.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $1,950.18 over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions; top campaign 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' alone consumed $1,463.12 — revenue per dollar is zero.
Meta CPL fell 43.63% week-over-week while leads rose 33.33% on lower spend; last 3 days (Aug 5–7) averaged 12.3 leads/day vs prior 3-day avg of ~0.3 — strong confirmed efficiency gain.
OVERDUE: Stripe products QA'd (due Jul 20) and GHL build complete (due Jul 31) both show no completed event — CRM money paths unverified, silently risking order/billing leaks.
OVERDUE: GBP item due Jul 15 has no completed event; GBP shows 36 directions actions but 0 calls and 0 web clicks over 28 days — profile may be driving foot traffic but leaking call volume.

GHL shows 118 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments over 28 days; 134 contacts vs 118 leads suggests intake is logging but no downstream activation is occurring — CRM intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads call-conversion tracking on 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls'; $1,950.18 spent with 0 conversions confirms pixel/call-tracking break, not ad underperformance.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads spent $1,950.18 over 28 days (top campaign $1,463.12) with 0 recorded conversions — this is almost certainly a tracking break, not zero calls. Audit the call-conversion tag and/or Google Ads call extension reporting against GHL call logs to confirm calls are occurring but not firing. Success check: at least one confirmed conversion event in Google Ads within 5 business days. Re-check by 2026-08-13.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget +20% (~$21/day increase from ~$105/day avg); CPL confirmed down 43.63% and 3-day lead avg at 12.3/day — efficiency headroom exists.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL dropped 43.63% week-over-week and leads rose 33.33% while spend fell 24.84%; the last 3 days (Aug 5–7) averaged 12.3 leads/day, confirming the trend is not noise. Raise Meta daily budget by 20% (approximately +$21/day from the ~$104–105/day current run rate). Success check: CPL remains below 28-day baseline of $25.60 and lead volume holds above 10/day. Re-check by 2026-08-11.

suggestions.text: Run Becklar deactivation dummy test and BWS duplicate-intake check per SOW; 0 won opps on 118 created confirms unverified money paths are a live billing-leak risk.
